items.name: Annuntia Open 2018

venue.name: [Annuntia-Scholengroep Wijnegem](http://www.annuntia.be/)
venue.details: Venue entrance is in Kerkhofstraat, so not the school's main entrance in Turnhoutsebaan.

items.information: The entry fees for competitors are €8 for both days and €5 for one day. This must be paid through online payment. See registration tab for more details. Competitor limit: 105

items.name: Croissy Open 2018
items.information: Competition is included in the exhibition "l'empire des jouets". Competitor limit is 100. Entrance is free. Public transportation is RER A "Chatou - Croissy" station, around 15'/ 1km by feet : RER A schedule : [https://www.transilien.com/en] The venue is a theatre room of 200 persons with bleacher and a stage. The exhibition "l'empire des jouets" is in the castle : [https://www.croissy.com/agenda/1156-l-empire-des-jouets-a-croissy.html]

items.name: Cube Factory League Luty 2018
items.information: Competitors limit: 80 for Saturday and 30 for Sunday. Registration fee: 25 PLN for Saturday and 35 PLN for both days.

items.name: Grind City 2018
items.information: To register, please follow all Instructions on the registration payment tab. Inproper completion of these steps may result in a delay of Registration. If you do not see your name on the compeitors tab after 48 hours of registering, please contact the organizers to resolve the issue.

items.name: Halifax Open 2018

venue.name: [Dalhousie University, Collaborative Health Education Building (CHEB)](https://www.dal.ca/campus-maps/building-directory/carleton-campus/cheb.html)
venue.details: Room C170, on your left when entering via University Ave. entrance or down the hall to the left from Summer St. entrance

items.information: There is no competitor limit. All information pertaining to the competition can be found on the CanadianCubing website. A tentative schedule can be found there aswell.

items.name: Imaginalia Open 2018
items.information: Para ser aceptado en la competición hay que pagar la inscripción por adelantado. Más información en la pestaña Pago.

items.name: Irvine Winter 2018

venue.name: Arnold O. Beckman High School Commons
venue.details: Enter through the front gate and make a left.

items.information: The competition will be held in the Anorld O. Beckman High School in the commons area. Due to the size of the venue, there will be a cap of **100** competitors. The cost of registration is **$20** for every competitor. $1 of your registration fee will go to CubingUSA and $1 will go towards funding SoCal cubing expenses. **We will not be taking registration at the door.** Only the competitor has to pay for the competition. See the tabs for more details.

items.name: Manchester Open 2018

venue.name: [Oasis Academy MediaCityUK](http://www.oasisacademymediacityuk.org)
venue.address: King William Street, Salford, Greater Manchester, M50 3UQ

items.information: Please make sure to read all the information in the tabs above.

items.name: Puget Sound Valentine 2018
items.information: **There is a 120 competitor limit and we ask that you please limit the number of guests that you bring.** * We also ask that guests allow competitors to sit at the tables. All the information needed can be found on the other tabs * While online registration is preferred, we will also take registration on site (cash only) If you have any questions, please direct them to thecubedude101@gmail.com

items.name: Reno Winter 2018

venue.name: University of Nevada, Reno
venue.address: Mathewson-IGT Knowledge Center, 1664 N Virginia St Reno, NV 89512
venue.details: Rotunda of the Mathewson-IGT Knowledge Center.

items.information: **THIS COMPETITION IS IN A DIFFERENT LOCATION THAN NORMAL!** The Rotunda is the big circular room on the entry-level floor of the Knowledge Center. **Same building** as previous competitions, but **new spot** in it. Registration fees for UNR/Davidson Academy students, staff, and faculty are at a reduced price of $10. All registration payments are to be made in cash on the day of the competition. There will be a competitor limit of 50.

items.name: Sangrah Cube Open 2018

venue.name: Govt. College of Engineering, Kannur
venue.address: Govt. College of Engineering, Kannur Parashinikadav PO, Kannur, Kerala

items.information: Registrations closes on 14th February 23:59 IST. Refer the [Registration & Payment](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SangrahCubeOpen2018#4019-registration-payment) tab to get the details on how to register.

items.name: Slow N Steady Winter 2018

venue.name: Adele H. Stamp Student Union
venue.address: 3100 Adele H. Stamp Student Union, College Park, MD 20742

items.information: Registration cost is $15 online. Registration at the door will not be allowed. Free for UMD students, faculty, staff, and alumni. There is a 300 person competitor limit. Please read the "Competitor Information" tab before registering.

items.name: TimerTon 2018

venue.name: [Casa de Cultura Profr. Jesús Romero Flores](https://www.google.com.mx/maps/place/Casa+de+Cultura+Profr.+Jes%C3%BAs+Romero+Flores/@19.4037644,-99.1724708,17z)
venue.details: Cerca a Metro Chilpancingo y Metrobús Nuevo León

items.information: Primer torneo oficial de Brick Cubes abierto a cualquiera que desee participar donde los ingresos obtenidos serán destinados a la renovación de Timers Speed Stacks Pro por Generación 4 para uso de la comunidad.

items.name: Ural Winter 2018
items.information: Registration will be closed on February 12 or when we reach 100 competitors. Registration fee is 400 RUB.

items.name: Vedruna Balaguer Open 2018
items.information: Fees: €5 regular / €3.75 AECR members. Registrations will not be accepted until you complete the [payment](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/VedrunaBalaguerOpen2018#3038-payment). No registrations will be accepted the day of the competition.

items.name: Xlingen Open 2018
items.information: Ein Teilnehmer der sich registriert und nicht bei der Competition erscheint, muss die Teilnahmekosten bei seiner nächsten Competition in der Schweiz bezahlen. --- A competitor who registers and doesn't show up at the competition will have to pay that registration fee at his next competition in Switzerland.
